{{Top|leg}}
A '''Thermosuit''' was a specialized suit used to keep people from freezing in cold environments. They were used in [[Deepsea mines|deapsea mining]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] also used thermosuit during his visit on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lur]].
